title: Materialize PowerShell foreach output before pipeline conversion
trigger_preconditions: foreach output must feed another cmdlet
failure_signature: The first x2 runner inventory probe piped directly after a foreach statement and stopped with an empty-pipe parser error.
candidate_workaround: Materialize foreach results into an explicit array before applying downstream PowerShell pipeline operators.
recurrence_guard: Use assignment or grouping whenever a foreach statement feeds a pipeline.
rollback: Stop the inventory probe and use one literal Test-Path command per runner if array materialization fails.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-local operational recovery only; no scientific, professional, authority, production, security-complete, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
